scope: Opt-in self-report memory suggestions with native UI approval through existing core and profile storage
verified: pLearn boolean defaults off and persists through existing profile schema/snapshot/save; pMemory must also be enabled
REST and Live expose memory.propose in the same model turn; timer notifications remain tool-free
Current-turn user text or streamed Live transcription supplies host-owned exact quote evidence; model cannot supply the internal proof flag
Missing or mismatched quote is a failed tool result; normal Live reply continues without a proposal
Suggestion leaves the settings profile unchanged; only one bounded candidate waits in domain RAM
Model cannot use memory.decide; learning-mode direct append is removed from model schema and rejected at submit
Actual Save/Dismiss UI sends stable request identity into registry/policy/TaskManager; approved data comes from actual domain candidate
Approval uses existing append/readback and profile refresh without second save; dismissal preserves profile bytes
Stale candidate, changed document/consent, newer candidate, prior dismissal and restart cannot silently save the old candidate
Decision replay preserves original result and does not duplicate the fact
Safe text rendering, visible review notice, explicit modal review, unknown lock and terminal expired-candidate cleanup
Existing explicit remember flow remains when suggestions are off; corrections/forgetting keep their existing explicit-command flow
intermediate_failures: Initial voice test used a text-turn-only synthetic resume socket that interpreted PCM and EOS as separate user turns. Replaced only the test transport with the existing PCM-capable socket fixture; both valid and unavailable source cases passed.
Browser test checked modal visibility before asynchronous existing panel import completed under parallel load. Added an explicit wait for the actual visible dialog; final eight groups passed.
limits: Exact quote matching verifies provenance only; semantic self/third-person, joke, quotation, sensitive-data and durability filtering is a model instruction, not a deterministic classifier
All model additions require clicking Save while suggestions are enabled, including explicit remember requests; voice approval is not implemented
Only one candidate waits in RAM; a newer candidate replaces it and restart discards it
Candidates are not saved as profile facts or exported as profile memory, but the existing local task journal can contain candidate text and quotes
Memory changes apply to the next model turn; forget does not erase provider history, prior replies, backups or task journal
No automatic conflict merge or retries; unknown decisions require reopening/checking persisted state
manual_acceptance: failed: user reported memory.propose failure; step reopened
commit: current step uncommitted pending user manual acceptance; no push

known_manual_failure.status: host-source fix under verification; not accepted
